notes: Supersedes v2.11.29 approval handling. Adds a final universal approval scope layer. RA/COSHH/SSW always expose Everyone, Departments and specific people even when the core audience decorator fails; Policy/Procedure/Other also support Positions. Uses the core approval IDs/classes so legacy responsibility checks see the selected scope. Restores review frequency and Next review date deterministically. Adds Move / classify to every document so Admin/Manager can change document type/index and custom folder at any time without re-uploading or losing version/history. Carries forward People-filter stability. No SQL required.
